selection: Both historical differences in the completed candidate01 audit; fixed diagnostic definitions inherited from diagnose_kitti_steps.py, with no setting selected or estimator rerun.
position_error: First-pose-normalized estimated position versus the same evaluated GT; no fitted alignment or rescaling.
paired_gap: Euclidean position difference between first-pose-normalized historical and current estimates. Rank fixed blocks by gap at end minus gap at start; retain every block.
limits: Only available committed historical trajectories can be paired. Error-growth blocks do not attribute a historical metric difference to a solver, filter extraction or runtime. Original and current OpenMP thread counts differ; no controlled thread-count experiment is performed. Frozen pre-extraction comparisons and owned input cleanup are outside this offline analysis.
